item.title: Mexican Open to continue
item.description: Mexican Open organisers insist the tournament is going ahead despite violence following the death of the country's most wanted drug baron. Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes, better known as "El Mencho", died in custody on Sunday shortly after being captured by Mexican special forces. The Mexican Open is due to get under way later in Acapulco, one of five Mexican states the US government has warned its citizens to shelter because of the violence. item.title: Voting open in MD O’Shea’s Community Builders competition
item.description: Voting is now open to choose the winner of the MD O’Shea’s Community Builders competition. Following an overwhelming response from 89 organisations across the Kerry, three finalists have been shortlisted. These three exceptional community projects are Firies Tidy Towns, Kerry Rape & Sexual Abuse Centre, and Lissivigeen National School. item.title: Ireland monitoring James Lowe's fitness
item.description: Ireland are monitoring James Lowe's fitness as the only fresh injury concern for Ireland after Saturday's Six Nations win over England at Twickenham. Jack Conan returns to training this week after dropping out of the Saturday matchday 23 due to illness. Harry Byrne, Edwin Edogbo, Cormac Izuchukwu and Cian Prendergast are part of a group of 11 players released from camp to play with their provinces in the URC this weekend Advertisement

item.title: Kerry dentist says updated legislation needed around unregistered dental practices
item.description: A Kerry dentist has renewed calls for updated legislations around unregistered dentists. Dr Colm O’Loghlen of Bridge Place Dental in Tralee says the Dental Council continue to operate under laws written in the 1980’s. According to the Irish Times, the statutory regulatory body for dentistry in Ireland, was unable to act in 80% of credible allegations about unregistered dentists since 2023. item.title: UEFA provisionally suspend Benfica player
item.description: UEFA have provisionally suspended Benfica's Gianluca Prestianni for one match as an investigation into alleged racism directed at Vinicius Junior continues He won't play in his club's Champions League game with Real Madrid on Wednesday The club said they will appeal the decision in a statement and reaffirmed their "unwavering commitment to combating all forms of racism and discrimination" Advertisement Real Madrid lead the play-off tie 1-nil ahead of the second leg

item.title: Kerry TD says 23 years’ worth of bed days lost in UHK last year
item.description: A Kerry TD has says that nearly 23 years’ worth of bed days were lost in University Hospital Kerry last year due to delays in the health system. That’s according to Sinn Féin TD, Pa Daly. Deputy Daly says that over 8000 bed days were lost at University Hospital Kerry due to delayed transfers of care or discharges in 2025. item.title: Hanrahan back for Munster
item.description: Kerry's JJ Hanrahan is back in training with Munster ahead of the Province's return to action. They host Zebre at Thomond Park from 5.30 on Saturday in the URC. Hanrahan is returning from a hamstring injury and there is further good news for Munster with Alex Kendellen (ankle), Jean Kleyn (head) and Calvin Nash (shoulder) also all returning to training.
